newsitem.title: USA: Bill proposed for TV coverage of federal courts.
newsitem.headline: Bill proposed for TV coverage of federal courts.

text.p: A bipartisan bill that would allow federal judges to permit television and radio coverage of trials on a case-by-case basis was introduced in the House Thursday.
Virtually no broadcast coverage of federal criminal or civil trials or appeal arguments is allowed, but 48 of the 50 states allow their court proceedings to be aired.

"The federal courts play a very important part in our government, and federal judges serve for life. The American people deserve an opportunity to see how they operate," Representative Steve Chabot, an Ohio Republican, said. He joined New York Democrat Charles Schumer in introducing the bill.
